title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I want to say something before I go off on another one: If you’re ever in disagreement with me - like the Comerica thing on the infield - definitely tell me. Because subconsciously I think I go for picking bones with the Tigers
And I think that perspective is very valuable and I don’t get enough of it

But they are just bad at handling these situations. And granted, I don’t know if they haven’t announced anything because all of their testing hasn’t come back yet - I heard otherwise yesterday - and I know it’s a very sensitive situation
But I KNOW that they had a positive test
And I tried to convey that to the proper people without explicitly saying that
Including Ron, who told me to ask the manager about it in the morning, wink-wink.
I called him just to say, hey, I’m not doing anything with this but I know you guys have been talking about it ... when is it coming kinda thing
So then in the morning, I’m expecting to get an answer, but the manager just dodges it again.
And Ron just isn’t responding
I got flak for my tweets, but I’m not asking the Tigers to identify these players, if they have not consented to it. The White Sox didn’t yesterday.
But given the nature of the PANDEMIC as a highly contagious virus and the NUMBERS that are skyrocketing, I think you have to say something regardless of if you use their name or not
Even if it’s “one or more” players in the organization tested positive.

I think you’re right. Your tweets didn’t convey that larger point you made, but that’s how this should be framed. Even if the Tigers do have someone test positive, then they say that person is quarantining and the team is taking all precautions to protect the health and safety of a player.
Exactly
I don’t even feel comfortable telling you the exact details of it, though if you think critically, you can probably identify it
So basically the stink I’m putting up is a little bit of “eyewash”
Because I obtained this information confidentially
The details of who tested positive? I think it’s pretty obvious based on which guys aren’t at camp
And I’m not going to break that trust for anything. So in reality, I can’t break it or I burn a huge bridge
So I’m trying to talk to people and say certain things that make it clear I know what’s going on and I could pop it open
“But hey, why don’t we talk this out instead, it’s a sensitive issue, you know?”
Which perhaps can ease some of the recent problems that have arisen kinda thing
So I’m bluffing. And though I don’t know if all the people who aren’t there have tested positive
I at least know one, but I can’t say that
Either way I just shot a few texts to Ron
Like, “Why do you have to be like this?”
He’s always the cool guy until the fire gets turned up
Then he turns into a weasel
https://twitter.com/beckjason/status/1280244383049277441
Just as I suspected
They keep planting this Nick Austin guy in there
Asking guys puff ass questions that almost seem rehearsed
Is it really planting someone? He’d normally be able to ask questions around the ballpark but can’t because of everything. So he has to use the same opportunities as everyone else right?
Planting was the wrong term
But also, good point
I mean, I think it says more about Beck that he’s like “this! This is the thing I have to tweet!”
Yeah I was just getting conspiracy theory with it
And also I chose call of duty as the thing I had to tweet
